# algolia_ingestion_task (Data Source)

Use this data source to read an Algolia Ingestion task's configuration, including its `input`, `notifications`, `policies`, and `cursor` in full: the Ingestion API does not redact a task's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    algolia = {
      source = "registry.terraform.io/algolia/algolia"
    }
  }
}

provider "algolia" {
  analytics_region = "us"
}

# Reads an existing task's configuration, including `input`, `notifications`,
# `policies`, and `cursor` in full: like the other Ingestion data sources
# (except algolia_ingestion_authentication), the API does not redact a
# task's configuration.
data "algolia_ingestion_task" "example" {
  task_id = "6c02aed6-9d1f-4fef-b2f6-9a5a3ea1e2f2"
}

output "task_action" {
  value = data.algolia_ingestion_task.example.action
}

output "task_enabled" {
  value = data.algolia_ingestion_task.example.enabled
}

output "task_next_run" {
  value = data.algolia_ingestion_task.example.next_run
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String) Universally unique identifier (UUID) of the task to read.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action to perform on the destination index for each record.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time when the resource was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `cron` (String) Cron expression for the task's schedule. Null for on-demand tasks.
- `cursor` (String) Date and time when the last cursor was created, in RFC 3339 format.
- `destination_id` (String) Universally unique identifier (UUID) of the destination this task writes to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the task is enabled.
- `failure_threshold` (Number) Maximum accepted percentage of failures for a task run to finish successfully.
- `id` (String) Terraform identifier for the resource. Equal to `task_id`.
- `input` (String) JSON-encoded configuration for the task's input. Null if the task needs no input.
- `last_run` (String) Date and time of the last time the task ran, in RFC 3339 format.
- `next_run` (String) Date and time of the next scheduled run of the task, in RFC 3339 format.
- `notifications` (String) JSON-encoded notification settings.
- `policies` (String) JSON-encoded task policies.
- `source_id` (String) Universally unique identifier (UUID) of the source this task reads from.
- `subscription_action` (String) Action to perform on the destination index for records ingested through a streaming/subscription-based source.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time when the resource was last updated, in RFC 3339 format.
